The FEYA 3 light semi flush ceiling light in polished chrome and smoked glass. A simple semi flush ceiling light designed in a modernist style with simple arms yet elegant arms. The height of the Feya ceiling light make it easy to place in most modern rooms where the ceiling height is often lower

The simple graphical design with large radiuses looks modern and fresh, working equally well against bold colours or monotone interior design schemes.

The Feya ceiling light takes a G9 lamp, we’d always recommend using one of our highly efficient LED lamps available in a warm 3000k temperature or a crisp cool white 4000k, take a look at our LED Lamps for the full range.

Web FAQs:
Useful to Know

Are the light bulbs included?
No these have to be bought separately, this allows you the opportunity to choose the colour temperature 2700k for a warm inviting feel, most people use this in the lounge or bedroom or 4000k for a more crisp white, most people use this in the kitchen or study but it's a personal preference. We have a range of highly efficient LED filament lamps, most are dimmable when using an LED compatible dimmer. Take a look at our LED Lamps for the full range.

My room has low ceilings is this light suitable?
Yes this light fitting sits close to the ceiling with a maximum height of 22cm making it the perfect choice where ceiling height is restricted, but please check the measurements in your exact room before purchase.

I have an older house, there is no earth cable where I want to fit my light, can I use this light?
Yes this product is double insulated and is designed to be safe to use where there is no earth cable. It can still be used where an earth cable is present. Your electrician should ensure that earth continuity is maintained in the rest of the wiring loop.

Web FAQs:
Useful to Know

Are the light bulbs included?
No these have to be bought separately, this allows you the opportunity to choose the colour temperature 2700k for a warm inviting feel, most people use this in the lounge or bedroom or 4000k for a more crisp white, most people use this in the kitchen or study but it's a personal preference. We have a range of highly efficient LED filament lamps, most are dimmable when using an LED compatible dimmer. Take a look at our LED Lamps for the full range.

What colour is the cable?
The cable is Clear.

Is the height of this ceiling light adjustable?
Yes this ceiling light is adjustable on installation

Is this real Crystal?
Yes, this is high quality real crystal, it is a heavy crystal which refracts the light giving a spectacular amount of colour. All our crystal is lead free.

My room has low ceilings is this light suitable?
Yes this light fitting is adjustable on installation to a minimum height of 32cm and is generally suitable for ceiling heights of 2.4m or greater, but please check the measurements in your exact room before purchase, we recommend the light hangs no lower than the door frame.

I have an older house, there is no earth cable where I want to fit my light, can I use this light?
Yes this product is double insulated and is designed to be safe to use where there is no earth cable. It can still be used where an earth cable is present. Your electrician should ensure that earth continuity is maintained in the rest of the wiring loop.

Who are we?



We are experts in lighting. For 50 years, dar Lighting has supplied independent lighting shops with our own-branded, quality lights and other products. We also sell online directly to the customer.

We partner with well-known retailers too, including the iconic British brand Laura Ashley. A staple for the modern country home, Laura Ashley Lighting encapsulates the very essence of romance and gentle maximalism.

The Laura Ashley Lighting collection is now available to buy direct from dar Lighting or through our many Independent Stockists on the high street.
